# Coil Coating


## Streamline processes, reduce costs, enhance product quality, and explore innovative coatings


View Locations

Coil coating stands at the forefront of modern pre-painted steel coil technology, transforming the way metal materials are finished before entering the manufacturing or construction process. As one of the fastest, most efficient, and environmentally responsible methods for applying coatings to steel and aluminum substrates, coil coating helps improve product quality, streamline operations, and reduce overall production costs.


## Coil coating offers cost savings, efficiency improvements, and reduced cycle times


AZZ Precoat Metals provides advanced coil coating solutions engineered to support demanding performance, operational, and aesthetic requirements across industries, including[construction](https://www.azz.com/precoat-construction-market) ,[HVAC](https://www.azz.com/precoat-hvac-market) ,[appliances](https://www.azz.com/precoat-appliances-market) ,[transportation](https://www.azz.com/precoat-transportation-market) ,[containers and packaging](https://www.azz.com/precoat-containers-and-packaging-market) ,[doors and windows](https://www.azz.com/precoat-doors-and-windows-market) , and[consumer products](https://www.azz.com/precoat-business-consumer-products-market) . By combining technical expertise, production flexibility, and integrated value-added processing capabilities, AZZ helps customers improve efficiency while delivering durable, high-performance finished products.


## Coil coating delivers significant manufacturing advantages


Unlike traditional post-paint methods where fabricated parts are individually painted after manufacturing, coil coating applies coatings to steel or aluminum coils before fabrication in a[continuous, highly controlled process](https://www.azz.com/coil-coating-process) .


**This coil coating process provides customers with several advantages, including:**


- Reduced labor and handling
- Faster production throughput
- Improved coating consistency
- Reduced rework and waste
- Lower operating costs
- Improved inventory management
- Reduced production complexity


Using prepainted metal also allows customers to focus more directly on their core production operations rather than managing in-house paint processes, environmental controls, and additional finishing operations. Coil coating helps simplify workflows while supporting greater production flexibility and efficiency.


For companies evaluating plant consolidations or manufacturing optimization initiatives, prepainted metal can also help reduce capital expenditures associated with maintaining in-house paint operations and related environmental compliance requirements.


## Reduce costs while improving product quality


Coil coating provides meaningful cost advantages compared to traditional post-paint methods. By operating within centralized, highly controlled environments, the process improves paint utilization, minimizes waste, and creates more consistent coating application across the entire metal surface.


**AZZ Precoat Metals helps customers improve:**


- Coating consistency
- Product durability
- Corrosion protection
- Appearance retention
- Manufacturing efficiency
- Lifecycle value


The controlled nature of the coil coating process also helps reduce variability commonly associated with post-paint operations. Coatings are applied evenly across flat metal surfaces before fabrication, helping ensure uniform coverage and improved overall coating quality.


This consistency enhances both product appearance and long-term field performance while helping reduce inefficiencies caused by inconsistent finishing results.


## Accelerate production and improve responsiveness


One of the most significant advantages of coil coating is the ability to reduce production cycle times and improve manufacturing responsiveness. By receiving prepainted metal ready for fabrication, customers can eliminate multiple downstream finishing steps and improve overall production flow.


**AZZ Precoat Metals further supports manufacturing responsiveness through:**


- Flexible production scheduling
- Quick turns on special colors and coatings
- Paint blend cell capabilities
- Integrated value-added processing services
- Toll processing flexibility
- Broad network and capacity across the U.S.


These capabilities help customers respond more effectively to changing market conditions, evolving inventory requirements, and shifting production demands while maintaining product quality and production continuity.


## Scale and flexibility to support modern manufacturing


As North America’s leading independent coil coater, AZZ Precoat Metals provides customers with the scale, production flexibility, and geographic reach needed to support evolving production demands and complex supply chains.


**With 14 strategically located Precoat facilities, 17 coating lines, and 19 value-added processing lines across the United States, AZZ helps customers improve:**


- Supply chain continuity
- Production flexibility
- Geographic responsiveness
- Freight efficiency
- Manufacturing coordination


Combined with integrated capabilities including[coil coating](https://www.azz.com/coil-coating) ,[slitting](https://www.azz.com/slitting) ,[embossing](https://www.azz.com/embossing) ,[laminating](https://www.azz.com/laminating) ,[printing](https://www.azz.com/printing) ,[shape correction](https://www.azz.com/shape-correction) , and[cut-to-length](https://www.azz.com/cut-to-length) processing, AZZ Precoat Metals delivers a unique one-stop-shop solution across multiple end markets and substrates.

## Enhance sustainability and environmental performance


Coil coating is widely recognized as one of the most environmentally responsible methods for finishing metal products. Because the process operates within highly controlled environments, it supports improved resource utilization, reduced emissions, and reduced waste generation compared to traditional post-paint operations.


At AZZ Precoat Metals, the[coil coating process](https://www.azz.com/coil-coating/) operates as a closed loop system where approximately 98% of VOCs are captured and converted to fuel, helping reduce environmental impact while improving process efficiency.


**Additional sustainability benefits include:**
• Lower energy consumption
• Improved paint utilization
• Reduced waste generation
• Recyclable steel and aluminum substrates
• Extended product service life
• Reduced maintenance requirements


Advanced coil coating technologies also support innovative applications such as cool roofing systems, energy-efficient building products, specialty coatings, and advanced architectural finishes designed to improve both environmental and operational performance.


## Innovation that supports product differentiation


AZZ Precoat Metals continues to invest in advanced coating technologies and specialty finishing capabilities designed to help customers differentiate their products in increasingly competitive markets.


**Capabilities include:**
• Custom colors
• Decorative finishes
• Embossed textures
• Specialty coatings
• Printing applications
• Natural-look finishes including wood grain and weathered effects


Combined with responsive customer support and technical expertise, AZZ helps customers create products that deliver both functional performance and enhanced visual appeal.


Through Coilzone®, customers also gain near real-time access to inventory, production, and shipping information, improving visibility and supply chain coordination throughout the production process.


## Why customers choose AZZ Precoat Metals


For over 60 years, AZZ Precoat Metals has helped customers improve efficiency, product quality, and long-term performance through advanced coil coating and integrated processing solutions.


**With one of North America’s largest independent coil coating networks, AZZ Precoat Metals combines:**


- Nationwide capacity
- Technical expertise
- Production flexibility
- Integrated processing capabilities
- Sustainable practices
- Responsive customer support


The result is a trusted coil coating and processing partner that helps customers reduce costs, improve efficiency, streamline production, and deliver high-quality products across a broad range of[industries and applications](https://www.azz.com/precoat-markets/) .
